title: Oral Temperature Morning-Evening Spread
dataSources: Oura stress and recovery (`oura:stress`), CPAP therapy sessions (`cpap:session`), oral thermometer readings (`thermometer:reading`), and body-composition scale snapshots (`bodycomp:reading`).
app: Personal health telemetry from Oura, OSCAR CPAP exports, oral thermometer readings, and smart body-composition scales sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and CSV exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=thermometer:reading
| eval daypart=if(tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H"))<12,"morning","evening")
| stats avg(temp_c) as avg_temp_c count as readings by daypart
| eventstats avg(avg_temp_c) as overall
| eval delta_from_overall=round(avg_temp_c-overall,2)
description: Examines morning versus evening oral temperature spread.
value: Comparing morning and evening readings gives a cleaner baseline for spotting real deviations later.
implementation: Send morning versus evening oral temperature spread events to `index=personal` with the fields used in this SPL and review the outliers or trend breaks regularly.
visualization: Table or chart of morning versus evening oral temperature spread, depending on the selected time range.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors what is happening with morning versus evening oral temperature spread, so odd changes stand out quickly.
